layman_headline: Market is fearful and most altcoins have already run up — patience is the play right now.
layman_explanation: The crypto market is in a 'Fear' state at 30/100, but improving from last week's deeper fear readings. Most swing trade candidates have already surged 10-70% in the past week, meaning the easy money has been made and chasing here carries high risk of a pullback. Bitcoin dominance at 56.4% means capital is flowing to BTC over altcoins, making alt trades riskier. Ethereum is the most interesting potential setup with RSI near oversold and massive TVL backing, but its chart risk/reward ratio is poor at current levels.
layman_action: Stay on the sidelines and wait for a pullback. If Ethereum dips to the $1,850 area with support holding, that could be a good entry. Don't chase coins that are already up 20-70% this week.
expert_reasoning: Applying validated Rule #9: ETH's chart R/R is 0.34x, well below the 0.5x threshold — this mechanically caps confidence and argues against entry at current levels. The RSI at 41 is approaching oversold and RSI has an 83% win rate in our signal credibility data, making it the most trustworthy signal here. However, BTC dominance at 56.4% creates a headwind for alts, and most candidates (KAITO RSI 83 overbought, UB +69% in 7d, SHIB +29% in 7d, AAVE +13% in 7d) are extended. Fear & Greed at 30 is improving from 26 yesterday — this trend is constructive but not yet signaling a clear reversal. The best approach is to wait for ETH to pull back to $1,850 support where the R/R improves to roughly 3.5x with a stop at $1,780.
risk_factors: BTC dominance at 56.4% continues to suppress altcoin performance — capital rotation into alts hasn't begun
Fear & Greed at 30 is improving but still in Fear territory — sentiment could reverse back toward Extreme Fear on any negative catalyst
No funding rate data available for any candidate, removing a key signal for gauging leverage positioning
watch_list: ETH price action near $1,850 support — a bounce there with rising volume would be an actionable entry
Fear & Greed movement toward 40+ would confirm sentiment recovery and reduce risk for alt entries
BTC dominance trend — a drop below 55% would signal rotation into alts and improve alt swing trade odds
market_context: Crypto market in Fear (30/100) but improving from Extreme Fear last week. BTC stable near $65K while alts show mixed signals — many have already rallied significantly, making fresh entries risky without a pullback.
context_banner: Market fear is easing but most swing candidates are already extended — disciplined patience and waiting for pullback entries offers the best risk-adjusted opportunity.
